provenance: 80 simulated devices, no real measured or clinical records
algorithm: Python Random; load cycles20..80 in5-point steps; exponential event time rate=(1/35)*exp(log(1.3)*(load-50)/10); independently drawn stop=12+48*U days. duration=min(event,stop), event=1 iff event<=stop.
scope: Illustrates estimator interfaces and exact covariate-unit rescaling; no population inference or model adequacy claim.
